Class InlineTuiConfig

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.InlineTuiConfig
public final class InlineTuiConfig extends Object
Configuration options for InlineTuiRunner.

Unlike TuiConfig, this configuration is tailored for inline displays that stay within the normal terminal flow (no alternate screen, cursor stays visible). 

InlineTuiConfig config = InlineTuiConfig.builder(4)
    .tickRate(Duration.ofMillis(50))  // For animations
    .clearOnClose(true)
    .build();

    • defaults

      public static InlineTuiConfig defaults(int height)
      Creates a default configuration for the given height.

      Defaults:

      • Tick rate: 40ms (~25fps, suitable for animations)
      • Poll timeout: 40ms
      • Clear on close: false
      • Bindings: defaults
      Parameters:
      height - the number of lines for the inline display
      Returns:
      a new configuration with defaults

    • scheduler

      public ScheduledExecutorService scheduler()
      Returns the externally-managed scheduler, or null if the runner should create its own.

      When an external scheduler is provided, the runner will NOT shut it down on close - the caller retains ownership and is responsible for its lifecycle.

      Returns:
      the external scheduler, or null to use an internally-managed one
